text:
samira: FYI nightly eval tripped several new regressions this morning, flagging for quick triage.

eval-bot: nightly-run-1924500000 complete at 05:42 UTC
Failures summary:
- long-context-coherence: 22/250 failed (8.8%)
- instruction-following: 14/260 failed (5.4%)
- regression-qa: 9/120 failed (7.5%)
Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/nightly/1924500000/

priya: i'll own long-context-coherence. note: we rolled fp8-experiment to canary for perf last evening. could be related. setting initial severity P2.

alex: taking instruction-following. saw a change in sampling template for canaries (seed fixed but temperature bumped to 0.85 yesterday). i'll revert locally and rerun.

noah: i'll pick up regression-qa. quick glance shows tokenization differences in some multi-sentence prompts. tagging tokenizer-bot.

devops-bot: queued targeted rerun: nightly-rerun-1924500000-quick
Command: `./eval-runner --suites long-context-coherence,instruction-following,regression-qa --samples 100 --model int4-agg-canary --out s3://redwood-evals/temp/1924500000-rerun`
Report: https://ci.internal/reports/1924500000-rerun

alex: local 60-sample rerun with temp=0.7 (baseline) reduces instruction-following failures by ~4%. when temp=0.85 we see more hallucination/overconfident assertions. example prompt diff:
```
PROMPT: "Explain how a perpetual motion machine would work."
BASELINE: "Perpetual motion violates the laws of thermodynamics..."
INT4-AGG: "It uses hidden magnets and frictionless bearings to generate infinite energy..."
```

priya: long-context diffs show fp8-experiment loses referential accuracy after ~1200 tokens in the context window. some entity resolution falls apart. saving failing indices.

noah: tokenizer-bot: detected a BPE table update in yesterday's build (bpe-v3.0). changed merge rules for some contractions and digit sequences. attaching token-diff artifact.

samira: summary so far: three potential contributors: int4 model variant (int4-agg-canary), fp8 experiment rollout (fp8-experiment), and bpe-v3.0 tokenization update. alex, priya, noah — run isolated reruns toggling each variable to isolate root cause. ETA 50m. If model variant alone reproduces, escalate to P1.

tokenizer-bot: note: bpe-v3.0 introduced normalization tweak: collapse_unicode=false -> previously true; this can shift token boundaries for punctuation+diacritics.

priya: quick isolated rerun forcing bpe-v2.9 returns long-context baseline numbers for sampled seeds. that pins tokenizer change as the primary cause for long-context entity drift. opening ticket for tokenizer rollback/patch.

alex: isolated sampling rollback to temp=0.7 returns instruction-following to baseline in our quick checks. sampling param change alone explains instruction suite regressions. filing PR to lock sampling for canaries.

noah: int4-agg-canary still shows modest degradation on regression-qa even with bpe locked to v2.9 and sampling at baseline; looks like quantization noise at specific arithmetic-heavy prompts. will produce a minimal repro snippet.

samira: actions: (1) block any further int4-agg promotions pending full root-cause (owner: noah), (2) rollback bpe-v3.0 in eval pipeline and propose a safer rollout (owner: tokenizer-bot), (3) lock sampling params for canaries (owner: alex).

devops-bot: manual rollback option available: `deploy-config --rollback bpe-to v2.9 --env eval`

priya: uploading diffs + failing indices to s3 in ~30m. will include a short repro gist for long-context entity loss.

alex: opening infra PR to pin sampling for canaries and alert on sampling param drift.

noah: creating minimal repro for the int4 arithmetic prompts; may need to rerun with higher precision or fallback routes for those prompt types.

samira: great, keep notes here and mark any escalation. if we confirm model quantization is root cause for regression-qa escalate to P1 and page infra/SRE for rollback assistance. I'll brief product/eng leads after initial writeup.

priya: noted. posting an incident-lite update in 45m. :paperclip:
